body.name: positive-definite contact witness
body.construction: Specialize to \(d=2\), \(\tau=1\), and \(K=[-2,2]\). For each \(h\in[0,\bar H]\), use \(P_{n,h}\) with covariance \(\Sigma(a_{n,h})\). The compatibility regime is \(C_{\delta}\geq\bar H\), \(c_{\beta}\leq1\), \(m_{\Sigma}\leq(3-\sqrt5)/2\), \(M_{\Sigma}\geq(3+\sqrt5)/2\), \(M_8\geq1920\{(3+\sqrt5)/2\}^4\), \(c_{\sigma}\leq\sqrt2\), \(C_{\sigma}\geq10\), and \(m_K\leq1\).
